## 1 Introduction (C6 C7)
- Fan hears about a local band at work: "what do they sound like? when do they play near me? can I get two seats together?"
- Small band sites: a Bandcamp link, an Instagram poster with dates, tickets on a platform with a mouse-only seat map
- Blind / keyboard users: can't choose a seat; deaf fans: no idea what the music is like
- Result: gives up → empty seats; the band depends on platforms it doesn't control
- Observed: [real local band sites I checked + what I saw]

## 2 What it is for (C6)
- Listen, find the gig and pick your seat in a couple of minutes, from any phone, for anyone
- Key 1: own audio player: big buttons, keyboard shortcuts, every song described in text
- Key 2: tour map → seat picker (arrows, max 6, taken seats) → printable ticket
- Key 3: shop cart that survives reloads + reading settings + Spanish/English + pausable animations
- Use case (keyboard only): K plays → tour → Xàtiva → "Elegir butaca" → Tab once + arrows + Space → empty form → error summary → fix → ticket → print
- Gain: album 125 s = 988 KB Opus vs 1498 KB MP3 (−34 %) · home 5 KB HTML + 7 KB CSS gzip · seats: 1 Tab + arrows instead of 96 Tabs · [Lighthouse scores] · [my time: buy 2 seats, mouse vs keyboard]
- Limits: nothing is sold or sent (no backend), fictitious band, synthesised music ≠ real recording

## 3 Technical (C5 + C3)
- **Decision 1 · own media pipeline + player (C5, RA3 RA4)**
  - Songs: `canciones.cjs` writes WAV (saw-wave power chords + `tanh` distortion, bass, synthetic drums) → `sonidos.sh`: ffmpeg `loudnorm` → MP3 96k (every browser) + Opus 64k (smaller); JS picks with `canPlayType`
  - Player: one `<audio>` without `controls`, my buttons with names; range input with `aria-valuetext` "0:12 de 0:21"; status line announces song changes; K J L M N P; Media Session (lock screen)
  - Equaliser: Web Audio `AnalyserNode` → SVG bars; vinyl spins only while playing; nothing moves with "less motion"
  - Audio-only content: text description per song (WCAG 1.2.1) + download links
  - Alt: `<audio controls>` (accessible but different per browser, no identity) · Spotify/Bandcamp embed (third-party cookies, weight, no control) · stock music (licences)
  - Trade-off: synthetic sound; a few hundred lines of JS to maintain
  - Runs: any static host with Range support (Apache yes); deps Node, ffmpeg; missing: HTTPS host, real recordings
- **Decision 2 · custom widgets that stay accessible, and proof (C3, RA5 RA6)**
  - Seats = `<button aria-pressed>`; roving tabindex (one seat in Tab order), arrows/Home/End; taken = `aria-disabled` + label "ocupada"; summary `role=status`
  - Map: HTML buttons over the SVG (`aria-pressed`) + same data in a table; panel `aria-live`
  - Cart + size guide: `<dialog>.showModal()` (focus trapped, Esc) → focus back to the opener; focus kept on the same +/− button after redraw
  - Ticket: print stylesheet `body:has(#entrada:not([hidden]))` prints only the ticket
  - Verification: `prueba.sh` 57 · pa11y WCAG2AA + axe 10/10 · 22 Puppeteer tests (incl. no Spanish text without English) (audio really plays, EQ moves, seats by keyboard, print media, cart focus, 375 px) · bugs: total time "Infinity:NaN" and seeking jumped to 0 → PHP built-in server ignores Range → `herramientas/servidor.php` · 375 px overflow on the tour page → screen-reader-only text inside the scrolling table escaped it → `position: relative` · map labels off the phone → labels on the land side
- Code roads: `herramientas/canciones.cjs` · `js/reproductor.js` · `js/entradas.js` · `scss/_mixins.scss` (`rasgado`)
